On my lunch break, I overheard a Middle Eastern guy and an Asian guy talking about their spouses. The Middle Eastern guy was talking about how they cook together every Saturday, but the Asian guy seemed appalled by the idea of helping to cook, and reported not even liking their spouse leaving the house when there was still housework to be done. Who tries to control their spouse?
A. The Asian guy
B. Unknown
C. The Middle Eastern guy
